title: Axis and low-dimensional cases of Levitin's disk-intersection conjecture
exact_target: Resolve an indefinite-pencil enclosure, generalize an indefinite Sturm–Liouville model, compare Nevanlinna zeros and poles, and classify periodic Schrödinger bases.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002500 (AIM-PHYSICS-0008). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Mathematical aspects of physics with non-self-adjoint operators; workshop 8–12 June 2015, Problems 11.1–13.1.

status_qualification: The original broad Sturm–Liouville extension and the zero/pole count conventions are preserved as questions to specify. Spectral domains and generalized eigenfunctions must be treated where needed; a statement about the named matrix alone does not settle this multi-question record. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
